requirement: Limit system access to authorized users, processes acting on behalf of authorized users, and devices (including other systems).
implementation_statement: Enclave accounts are created in SYS-01 only after U.S.-person verification and manager approval. MES (SYS-06) uses local accounts and shared shop-floor terminal logins. Two departed employees' enclave accounts were still enabled (P07). Planned: Move MES authentication to SYS-01 named accounts; HR-triggered same-day disable; quarterly account review (target 2026-11-30)
evidence: IdP account export 2026-07-20; MES user table; P07 AC-2 test

requirement: Limit system access to the types of transactions and functions that authorized users are permitted to execute.
implementation_statement: PLM roles limit users to the projects and functions (view, check-in, release) their job requires. Enclave suite roles restrict administration to 4 named administrators
evidence: PLM role matrix; enclave suite admin role export

requirement: Control the flow of CUI in accordance with approved authorizations.
implementation_statement: External sharing in SYS-02 is limited to an allow-list of 6 customer and supplier domains. The SFTP gateway has no per-partner folder restrictions, and CUI flows are not documented in the SSP. Planned: Document CUI flows in SSP section 8; per-partner SFTP folders (target 2026-10-31)

requirement: Separate the duties of individuals to reduce the risk of malevolent activity without collusion.
implementation_statement: Two systems administrators hold all administrative roles, including audit log settings. Duties are not defined in writing. Planned: Define duties; move log settings to IT Manager-only role (see 3.3.9) (target 2026-12-31)
evidence: Admin role export; interview IT Manager 2026-07-15

requirement: Employ the principle of least privilege, including for specific security functions and privileged accounts.
implementation_statement: Enclave laptop users are standard users. All 24 engineers have local administrator rights on CAD workstations for CAD plug-ins. Planned: Remove local admin; package CAD plug-ins through device management (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Use non-privileged accounts or roles when accessing nonsecurity functions
implementation_statement: Administrators use separate privileged accounts, activated just in time with hardware security keys, and standard accounts for email and browsing
evidence: IdP privileged role assignments; admin account list

requirement: Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions and capture the execution of such functions in audit logs.
implementation_statement: Privileged role activation is logged in SYS-01. Engineers with local admin (3.1.5) and MES operators with program-edit rights can run privileged functions without separate logging. Planned: Covered by 3.1.5 and MES account remediation (target 2026-11-30)
evidence: IdP audit log sample; MES role table

requirement: Limit unsuccessful logon attempts.
implementation_statement: SYS-01 locks accounts after 10 failed attempts. MES local accounts have no lockout. Planned: Resolved when MES moves to SYS-01 authentication (target 2026-11-30)
evidence: IdP lockout policy; MES security settings

requirement: Provide privacy and security notices consistent with applicable CUI rules.
implementation_statement: A logon banner with CUI and monitoring notice displays on enclave endpoints, virtual desktops, and MES terminals

requirement: Use session lock with pattern-hiding displays to prevent access and viewing of data after a period of inactivity
implementation_statement: Enclave endpoints lock after 15 minutes with a pattern-hiding screen. Session lock is disabled on the 14 MES terminals. Planned: Badge-tap lock on MES terminals (target 2026-12-31)

requirement: Terminate (automatically) a user session after a defined condition.
implementation_statement: Virtual desktop and enclave suite sessions end after 30 minutes idle and 12 hours total

requirement: Monitor and control remote access sessions.
implementation_statement: Remote access is only through the enclave virtual desktop gateway with MFA and a compliant-device check. Sign-ins are logged and risky sign-ins alert IT

requirement: Employ cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of remote access sessions.
implementation_statement: The virtual desktop gateway uses TLS through the provider's FIPS-validated modules, as stated in the customer responsibility matrix

requirement: Route remote access via managed access control points.
implementation_statement: All remote access routes through the single managed virtual desktop gateway. There is no remote-access VPN

requirement: Authorize remote execution of privileged commands and remote access to security-relevant information.
implementation_statement: Remote privileged commands require privileged role activation with approval by the IT Manager

requirement: Authorize wireless access prior to allowing such connections
implementation_statement: No wireless access points exist on enclave VLANs. Plant Wi-Fi is corporate and cannot route to enclave VLANs
evidence: Firewall rule review 2026-07-22; wireless controller inventory

requirement: Protect wireless access using authentication and encryption
implementation_statement: Corporate Wi-Fi used by enclave laptops for internet access uses enterprise authentication and encryption

requirement: Control connection of mobile devices.
implementation_statement: Conditional access blocks enclave suite access from mobile phones except the authenticator app. Enclave laptops are enrolled in device management

requirement: Encrypt CUI on mobile devices and mobile computing platforms.[23]
implementation_statement: All 16 enclave laptops use full-disk encryption with the operating system's FIPS-validated module

requirement: Verify and control/limit connections to and use of external systems.
implementation_statement: Personal devices are blocked from the enclave. Connections to external systems are not controlled: enclave desktops can reach public AI chatbots, and SFTP partner connections have no written terms of use. Planned: Block unapproved AI and file-sharing sites from the enclave; written terms for SFTP partners (target 2026-10-31)
evidence: Web filter policy; interview Director of Engineering 2026-07-16

requirement: Limit use of portable storage devices on external systems.
implementation_statement: USB storage is blocked on enclave laptops. No rule limits use of company USB drives on external systems. Planned: Add rule to POL-04; see 3.8.7 media program (target 2026-12-31)

requirement: Control CUI posted or processed on publicly accessible systems.
implementation_statement: The public website is managed by Sales. Technical images and part information need Contracts Manager release review before posting

requirement: Ensure that managers, systems administrators, and users of organizational systems are made aware of the security risks associated with their activities and of the applicable policies, standards, and procedures related to the security of those systems.
implementation_statement: Annual general security awareness training is completed by 96% of staff. It does not cover CUI handling, export control release, or the company's policies. Planned: CUI and export control module for all enclave users and shop-floor leads (target 2026-12-31)

requirement: Ensure that personnel are trained to carry out their assigned information security-related duties and responsibilities.
implementation_statement: No role-based training for administrators, engineers who mark CUI, or quality staff who distribute drawings. Planned: Role-based training for administrators, engineers, and quality staff (target 2026-12-31)

requirement: Provide security awareness training on recognizing and reporting potential indicators of insider threat.
implementation_statement: No insider threat awareness content. Planned: Add insider threat indicators and reporting to the annual module (target 2026-12-31)

requirement: Create and retain system audit logs and records to the extent needed to enable the monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized system activity
implementation_statement: SYS-01, SYS-02, and SYS-03 logs flow to a cloud log workspace with 90-day retention. MES, DNC, and enclave firewall logs are not collected. Planned: Add firewall, MES, and DNC logs; 1-year retention (target 2026-12-31)
evidence: Log workspace data sources; retention setting

requirement: Ensure that the actions of individual system users can be uniquely traced to those users, so they can be held accountable for their actions.
implementation_statement: Cloud and endpoint logs trace to named users. MES actions trace to shared terminal logins, not to individuals. Planned: Named MES accounts (see 3.1.1) (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Review and update logged events.
implementation_statement: Logged event types have never been reviewed or updated. Planned: Annual logged-event review, first in 2026 Q4 (target 2026-12-31)

requirement: Alert in the event of an audit logging process failure.
implementation_statement: No alert if a log source stops sending. Planned: Heartbeat alert for each log source (target 2026-12-31)

requirement: Correlate audit record review, analysis, and reporting processes for investigation and response to indications of unlawful, unauthorized, suspicious, or unusual activity.
implementation_statement: Logs are collected but nobody reviews or correlates them. Planned: Weekly review with alert rules for mass download, impossible travel, and new inbox rules (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Provide audit record reduction and report generation to support on-demand analysis and reporting.
implementation_statement: The log workspace supports queries, but no saved reports exist. Planned: Saved queries for the weekly review (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Provide a system capability that compares and synchronizes internal system clocks with an authoritative source to generate time stamps for audit records
implementation_statement: Enclave systems, MES, and DNC synchronize to an authoritative time source

requirement: Protect audit information and audit logging tools from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion.
implementation_statement: Log workspace access is limited to the IT Manager and Systems Administrators; the provider protects stored logs from alteration
evidence: Log workspace access list; provider CRM

requirement: Limit management of audit logging functionality to a subset of privileged users.
implementation_statement: All 4 administrator accounts can change logging settings. Planned: Create a log-admin role held by the IT Manager only (target 2026-12-31)

requirement: Establish and maintain baseline configurations and inventories of organizational systems (including hardware, software, firmware, and documentation) throughout the respective system development life cycles.
implementation_statement: Device management inventories enclave endpoints. VM and MES baselines are not documented. The OT inventory spreadsheet (CNC, CMM) was last updated in 2024. Planned: Document baselines for endpoints, VMs, MES; update OT inventory with CMMC asset categories (target 2026-12-31)

requirement: Establish and enforce security configuration settings for information technology products employed in organizational systems.
implementation_statement: Endpoint security baselines are enforced through device management. VMs and the MES server are not hardened to a documented standard. Planned: Apply hardening benchmarks to VMs and MES; record exceptions (target 2026-12-31)
evidence: Configuration profiles; MES server settings review

requirement: Track, review, approve or disapprove, and log changes to organizational systems.
implementation_statement: Changes to enclave systems are made without a request, review, or log. Planned: Change tickets with approval for enclave changes (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Analyze the security impact of changes prior to implementation.
implementation_statement: No security impact analysis before changes. The MES upgrade (2025) and SFTP gateway (2025) were added without review. Planned: Security impact section in change tickets (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Define, document, approve, and enforce physical and logical access restrictions associated with changes to organizational systems.
implementation_statement: Only named administrators can change cloud, endpoint, and firewall configurations. MES configuration changes are limited to the Manufacturing Systems Engineer's account
evidence: Admin role export; MES admin account list

requirement: Employ the principle of least functionality by configuring organizational systems to provide only essential capabilities.
implementation_statement: Enclave endpoint images remove unneeded features. The MES server runs a web administration service and remote desktop open to the whole shop-floor VLAN. Planned: Disable unneeded MES services; restrict remote desktop to admin hosts (target 2026-11-30)
evidence: MES server service list; firewall rules

requirement: Restrict, disable, or prevent the use of nonessential programs, functions, ports, protocols, and services.
implementation_statement: Endpoint and VM baselines block nonessential programs, ports, and protocols through device management and network security groups
evidence: Configuration profiles; network security group export

requirement: Apply deny-by-exception (blacklisting) policy to prevent the use of unauthorized software or deny-all, permit-by-exception (whitelisting) policy to allow the execution of authorized software.
implementation_statement: Application allowlisting runs in audit mode on enclave endpoints. It is not enforced. Planned: Enforce allowlisting on endpoints and MES (target 2027-01-15)

requirement: Control and monitor user-installed software.
implementation_statement: Enclave laptop users cannot install software. Engineers with local admin on CAD workstations can (see 3.1.5). Planned: Resolved by 3.1.5 (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Identify system users, processes acting on behalf of users, and devices.
implementation_statement: SYS-01 identifies enclave users and enrolled devices. MES terminals use shared logins and the DNC uses a shared service account. Planned: Named MES accounts through SYS-01; individual DNC service accounts (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Authenticate (or verify) the identities of users, processes, or devices, as a prerequisite to allowing access to organizational systems.
implementation_statement: Enclave users authenticate through SYS-01. MES terminals authenticate with shared passwords known to about 40 operators. Planned: Same as 3.5.1 (target 2026-11-30)
evidence: MES user table; interview Plant Manager 2026-07-17

requirement: Use multifactor authentication for local and network access to privileged accounts and for network access to non-privileged accounts.[24] [25].
implementation_statement: MFA is required for all SYS-01 accounts (privileged and non-privileged network access). MES local accounts, including its local administrator, have no MFA. Planned: MES sign-in through SYS-01 with MFA; badge-plus-PIN at terminals (target 2026-11-30)
evidence: Conditional access policy; MES authentication settings

requirement: Employ replay-resistant authentication mechanisms for network access to privileged and non-privileged accounts.
implementation_statement: SYS-01 uses replay-resistant modern authentication. MES uses a legacy challenge-response protocol. Planned: Resolved by MES move to SYS-01 (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Prevent reuse of identifiers for a defined period.
implementation_statement: Identifiers are never reused. Departed users' identifiers stay reserved

requirement: Disable identifiers after a defined period of inactivity.
implementation_statement: No automatic disable after inactivity. Two departed users' accounts were still enabled (P07). Planned: Disable after 45 days inactive; monthly report (target 2026-10-31)

requirement: Enforce a minimum password complexity and change of characters when new passwords are created.
implementation_statement: SYS-01 enforces a 14-character minimum and a banned-password list. MES local passwords are 6 characters and shared. Planned: Resolved by MES move to SYS-01 (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Prohibit password reuse for a specified number of generations.
implementation_statement: SYS-01 prevents reuse. MES does not. Planned: Resolved by MES move to SYS-01 (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Allow temporary password use for system logons with an immediate change to a permanent password.
implementation_statement: New users receive a temporary access pass that must be changed at first sign-in

requirement: Store and transmit only cryptographically-protected passwords.
implementation_statement: Passwords are hashed in SYS-01. The DNC service account password is stored in plain text in a configuration file on the DNC server. Planned: Move credential to the key vault; rotate (target 2026-10-31)

requirement: Obscure feedback of authentication information
implementation_statement: Password entry is masked on all enclave systems and MES

requirement: Establish an operational incident-handling capability for organizational systems that includes preparation, detection, analysis, containment, recovery, and user response activities.
implementation_statement: EDR detects and isolates hosts. A 2024 incident response outline exists, with no DIBNet steps. The CUI exfiltration runbook (P08) was approved 2026-08-31 and is untested. Planned: Adopt POL-03 and P08; forensic retainer; tabletop (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Track, document, and report incidents to designated officials and/or authorities both internal and external to the organization.
implementation_statement: Incidents are tracked ad hoc in email. The company holds no DoD-approved medium assurance certificate and has never practiced a DIBNet report. Planned: Obtain medium assurance certificates for 2 reporters; incident log; DIBNet drill (target 2026-10-31)

requirement: Test the organizational incident response capability.
implementation_statement: Incident response has never been tested. Planned: Annual tabletop; first on 2026-11-18 (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Perform maintenance on organizational systems.[26].
implementation_statement: IT maintenance is scheduled through tickets. CNC and CMM maintenance is scheduled in the plant maintenance system

requirement: Provide controls on the tools, techniques, mechanisms, and personnel used to conduct system maintenance.
implementation_statement: Machine-tool vendor technicians are escorted, their work is logged, and IT approves remote support tools

requirement: Ensure equipment removed for off-site maintenance is sanitized of any CUI.
implementation_statement: No procedure to sanitize CNC controller storage or MES drives sent off site for repair. Planned: Add to POL-04 media rules; vendor attestation (target 2026-12-31)

requirement: Check media containing diagnostic and test programs for malicious code before the media are used in organizational systems.
implementation_statement: Vendor diagnostic USB drives and laptops are connected to CNC controllers without a malware scan. Planned: Scanning kiosk for vendor media at the maintenance cage (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Require multifactor authentication to establish nonlocal maintenance sessions via external network connections and terminate such connections when nonlocal maintenance is complete.
implementation_statement: MES vendor remote support uses a guest virtual desktop account with MFA, opened on request and watched by the Manufacturing Systems Engineer
evidence: Remote support procedure; session log sample

requirement: Supervise the maintenance activities of maintenance personnel without required access authorization.
implementation_statement: Maintenance personnel without access authorization are escorted at all times

requirement: Protect (i.e., physically control and securely store) system media containing CUI, both paper and digital.
implementation_statement: Digital media is protected. Printed drawings and travelers on the shop floor are left at machines and in open bins. Planned: Drawing cabinets at cells; clean-desk rule; print only what is needed (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Limit access to CUI on system media to authorized users
implementation_statement: Access to digital CUI is role based. Printed drawings are readable by anyone on the floor, including escorted visitors. Planned: Cover or remove drawings in visitor routes; see 3.10.3 (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Sanitize or destroy system media containing CUI before disposal or release for reuse.
implementation_statement: IT drives are wiped with certificates. Printed drawings go to general recycling bins. Planned: Locked shred bins at cells; certificate of destruction from shredding vendor (target 2026-10-31)

requirement: Mark media with necessary CUI markings and distribution limitations.[27]
implementation_statement: PLM title blocks carry the prime's distribution statement. MES-printed travelers and drawing views carry no CUI marking. Planned: Add CUI banner and distribution statement to MES print templates (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Control access to media containing CUI and maintain accountability for media during transport outside of controlled areas.
implementation_statement: Paper drawing copies travel with parts to outside processors in unsealed envelopes. Planned: Sealed envelopes; send drawings only by SFTP where possible (target 2026-12-31)

requirement: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of CUI stored on digital media during transport unless otherwise protected by alternative physical safeguards.
implementation_statement: USB drives used for legacy CNC machines are not encrypted. Planned: Encrypted drives, or replace USB with DNC (see 3.8.7) (target 2027-01-31)

requirement: Control the use of removable media on system components.
implementation_statement: Any USB drive can be used on the 6 legacy CNC machines. There is no removable media control or list of approved drives. Planned: Connect the 6 machines to DNC through a serial gateway; approved-drive list until then (target 2027-01-31)

requirement: Prohibit the use of portable storage devices when such devices have no identifiable owner.
implementation_statement: Unlabeled generic USB drives are kept in an open drawer at the programming desk. Planned: Issue labeled, inventoried drives; destroy the rest (target 2026-10-31)

requirement: Protect the confidentiality of backup CUI at storage locations.
implementation_statement: PLM backups are encrypted in the backup vault with provider FIPS-validated modules; access is limited to 2 administrators

requirement: Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to organizational systems containing CUI.
implementation_statement: Background checks and U.S.-person verification are completed before enclave access
evidence: HR checklist; export compliance screening log

requirement: Ensure that organizational systems containing CUI are protected during and after personnel actions such as terminations and transfers
implementation_statement: HR emails IT at termination. Two departed employees' enclave accounts were still enabled 19 and 45 days after departure. Planned: Same-day disable triggered by HR; transfer review (target 2026-10-31)

requirement: Limit physical access to organizational systems, equipment, and the respective operating environments to authorized individuals.
implementation_statement: Badge access controls the plant. The engineering wing and server room are restricted to badge groups

requirement: Protect and monitor the physical facility and support infrastructure for organizational systems.
implementation_statement: Cameras cover entrances, the dock, and the server room. The alarm is monitored after hours

requirement: Escort visitors and monitor visitor activity.
implementation_statement: Visitors sign in at reception. Escort on the shop floor is inconsistent, including foreign-national employees of commercial customers. Planned: Escort rule enforced; visitor badges that expire daily; route map avoiding CUI areas (target 2026-10-31)
evidence: Visitor log review (30 days); interview Plant Manager

requirement: Maintain audit logs of physical access.
implementation_statement: Badge logs are kept. The paper visitor log misses exit times and host names on 11 of 30 days. Planned: Electronic visitor log (target 2026-10-31)

requirement: Control and manage physical access devices.
implementation_statement: Badges are issued and revoked by the Facilities and Security Coordinator. Server room keys are logged

requirement: Enforce safeguarding measures for CUI at alternate work sites.
implementation_statement: Engineers may work remotely through virtual desktops. No written rules cover printed CUI at home. Planned: Telework rules in POL-04: no printing of CUI at home (target 2026-12-31)

requirement: Periodically assess the risk to organizational operations (including mission, functions, image, or reputation), organizational assets, and individuals, resulting from the operation of organizational systems and the associated processing, storage, or transmission of CUI
implementation_statement: A risk assessment using NIST SP 800-30 Rev. 1 was completed 2026-07-24 (P01) and approved 2026-08-31. Annual update scheduled

requirement: Scan for vulnerabilities in organizational systems and applications periodically and when new vulnerabilities affecting those systems and applications are identified.
implementation_statement: No vulnerability scanning of enclave VMs, endpoints, or MES. Planned: Monthly authenticated scans of enclave and MES (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Remediate vulnerabilities in accordance with risk assessments.
implementation_statement: Endpoints are patched monthly. VM and MES vulnerabilities are handled ad hoc. Planned: Remediation timelines by severity (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Periodically assess the security controls in organizational systems to determine if the controls are effective in their application.
implementation_statement: The 2024 self-assessment had no evidence. The 2026 assessment (P07) covered 20 controls. No annual full assessment cycle. Planned: Annual full self-assessment against SP 800-171A objectives (target 2026-12-31)

requirement: Develop and implement plans of action designed to correct deficiencies and reduce or eliminate vulnerabilities in organizational systems.
implementation_statement: The 2024 POA&M was never updated. A new POA&M (P07) was created 2026-08-07. Planned: Monthly POA&M review by the Vice President of Operations (target 2026-09-30)

requirement: Monitor security controls on an ongoing basis to ensure the continued effectiveness of the controls.
implementation_statement: No ongoing monitoring of control effectiveness. Planned: Monthly control metrics (accounts, patches, scans, logs, training) to leadership (target 2026-12-31)

requirement: Develop, document, and periodically update system security plans that describe system boundaries, system environments of operation, how security requirements are implemented, and the relationships with or connections to other systems.[28]
implementation_statement: The SSP (2024-08-30) omits the MES upgrade, SFTP gateway, virtual desktops, and Specialized Assets. SSP v2.0 (P02) was approved 2026-08-31. Planned: SSP v2.0 approved 2026-08-31; update on every significant change (target 2026-08-31)

requirement: Monitor, control, and protect communications (i.e., information transmitted or received by organizational systems) at the external boundaries and key internal boundaries of organizational systems.
implementation_statement: The enclave firewall separates enclave VLANs from the corporate network; cloud network security groups protect the SYS-03 subnets
evidence: Firewall rule review 2026-07-22; network security group export

requirement: Employ architectural designs, software development techniques, and systems engineering principles that promote effective information security within organizational systems.
implementation_statement: The enclave follows a documented segmented design: cloud landing zone with separate subnets, VLAN segmentation at the plant

requirement: Separate user functionality from system management functionality.
implementation_statement: Administration uses separate privileged accounts and admin-only management interfaces

requirement: Prevent unauthorized and unintended information transfer via shared system resources.
implementation_statement: Virtual desktops are non-persistent; the provider isolates shared resources (CRM)

requirement: Implement subnetworks for publicly accessible system components that are physically or logically separated from internal networks.
implementation_statement: The SFTP gateway, the only publicly reachable component, sits in its own subnet separated from the PLM subnet

requirement: Deny network communications traffic by default and allow network communications traffic by exception (i.e., deny all, permit by exception).
implementation_statement: Cloud network security groups deny by default. The plant enclave firewall allows any outbound traffic from the engineering VLAN. Planned: Deny-by-default outbound with an allow-list (target 2026-11-30)

requirement: Prevent remote devices from simultaneously establishing non-remote connections with organizational systems and communicating via some other connection to resources in external networks (i.e., split tunneling).
implementation_statement: There is no remote-access VPN; remote users work inside virtual desktops, so split tunneling cannot occur

requirement: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure of CUI during transmission unless otherwise protected by alternative physical safeguards.
implementation_statement: All CUI transfer paths are encrypted in transit: TLS for SYS-02 and the virtual desktops, SSH for the SFTP gateway, IPsec for the site-to-site VPN
evidence: TLS scan; SFTP and VPN configurations

requirement: Terminate network connections associated with communications sessions at the end of the sessions or after a defined period of inactivity.
implementation_statement: Virtual desktop and VPN sessions drop after inactivity

requirement: Establish and manage cryptographic keys for cryptography employed in organizational systems.
implementation_statement: Provider-managed keys protect cloud storage. The site-to-site VPN pre-shared key has never been rotated and is stored in a spreadsheet. Planned: Move keys to the key vault; rotate annually (target 2026-12-31)

requirement: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography when used to protect the confidentiality of CUI.
implementation_statement: Encryption is employed on all paths. FIPS validation is confirmed for SYS-02, SYS-03 storage, and endpoints. It is not confirmed for the SFTP gateway (VM crypto library not in FIPS mode) or the plant firewall VPN (FIPS mode not enabled). Planned: Enable FIPS mode on the SFTP VM and firewall; record module certificate numbers (target 2026-11-30)
evidence: Provider CRM; SFTP and firewall configuration review

requirement: Prohibit remote activation of collaborative computing devices and provide indication of devices in use to users present at the device.[29].
implementation_statement: Conference room cameras cannot be activated remotely and show an in-use light

requirement: Control and monitor the use of mobile code.
implementation_statement: Browser policies and enclave suite settings block macros from the internet and unapproved mobile code

requirement: Control and monitor the use of Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) technologies.
implementation_statement: No VoIP components in the enclave boundary. Plant phones are on the corporate network

requirement: Protect the authenticity of communications sessions.
implementation_statement: Session authenticity is protected by TLS and token binding in the enclave suite and virtual desktops

requirement: Protect the confidentiality of CUI at rest.
implementation_statement: Cloud storage and laptops are encrypted at rest. The MES server disk and DNC program share are not encrypted. Planned: Enable disk encryption on MES and DNC servers (target 2026-12-31)

requirement: Identify, report, and correct system flaws in a timely manner.
implementation_statement: Endpoints are patched monthly. VMs are patched manually and MES quarterly. CNC controllers cannot be patched (Specialized Assets, documented in SSP v2.0). Planned: Monthly VM and MES patching with a 30-day critical timeline (target 2026-11-30)
evidence: Patch compliance report; MES patch history

requirement: Provide protection from malicious code at designated locations within organizational systems.
implementation_statement: EDR runs on enclave endpoints, VMs, and the MES and DNC servers

requirement: Monitor system security alerts and advisories and take action in response.
implementation_statement: The IT Manager receives CISA and vendor advisories, including industrial control advisories; actions are tracked in tickets

requirement: Update malicious code protection mechanisms when new releases are available.
implementation_statement: EDR signatures and engines update automatically

requirement: Perform periodic scans of organizational systems and real-time scans of files from external sources as files are downloaded, opened, or executed.
implementation_statement: EDR scans files in real time when downloaded or opened, and runs weekly full scans

requirement: Monitor organizational systems, including inbound and outbound communications traffic, to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks.
implementation_statement: EDR alerts are reviewed during business hours only. There is no monitoring of outbound traffic or unusual downloads. Planned: 24x7 managed detection for enclave; mass-download alerts (target 2027-01-31)
evidence: EDR alert queue; interview IT Manager

requirement: Identify unauthorized use of organizational systems.
implementation_statement: No method to identify unauthorized use (for example, mass downloads or off-hours access). Planned: Use-based alerts in the log workspace (see 3.3.5) (target 2026-12-31)
